item.title: Climate change can worsen income inequality
item.description: A study published in Sustainable Development that analyzed the relationship between climate change and income inequality for 23 emerging market economies from 2002 to 2022 found that greater climate pressure is positively associated with income inequality across three different inequality indicators (the Gini coefficient, the Palma ratio and the Theil index).
